transcript.content: Persistent anxiety and stress about gardening yields (especially tomatoes); it intensified a few months ago when I noticed the tomatoes growing slower than usual; every time I check on or think about the garden I worry the whole season's harvest will fail.

[System B PsychAgent] Thank you for sharing your current situation (Persistent anxiety and pressure around the gardening harvest (especially tomatoes), noticing a few months ago that the tomatoes were growing worse than...). In our BT counseling framework, we will explore your core concerns and cognitive patterns.
